slug: 2026-06-09 Meta backs NDPC in landmark privacy initiative

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports the NDPC, headed by National Commissioner and CEO Dr Vincent Olatunji, is acting under the Act, launching a programme with Meta; no event date given, so the published date is used.

ITWeb Africa reports a court-approved settlement reached in 2025 between the NDPC and Meta after regulatory proceedings over handling of Nigerian users' data, under which Meta funds a two-year programme (M-SIDP); the month is not given.
